tagline.text: Razona con figuras, números y patrones, construyéndolos.
tagline.source: Reason with shapes, numbers and patterns — by building them.

summary.text: Una introducción práctica a pensar como un matemático. En lugar de memorizar fórmulas, construyes figuras, pones a prueba ideas y descubres por qué funcionan las reglas.
summary.source: A hands-on introduction to thinking like a mathematician. Instead of memorising formulas, you build shapes, test ideas and discover why the rules work.

outcomes.0.source: Measure area by covering shapes with unit squares

outcomes.1.text: Explicar por qué el área de un rectángulo es ancho × alto
outcomes.1.source: Explain why a rectangle's area is width × height

outcomes.2.text: Distinguir área y perímetro, y predecir cómo cambian
outcomes.2.source: Tell area and perimeter apart, and predict how they change

outcomes.3.text: Calcular el área de cualquier triángulo en una cuadrícula
outcomes.3.source: Find the area of any triangle on a grid

chapters.#area-and-shape.summary.text: Qué significa que una figura sea «más grande» que otra.
chapters.#area-and-shape.summary.source: What it means for one shape to be "bigger" than another.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: ¿Qué jardín es más grande?
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Which garden is bigger?

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Descubre qué mide el área cubriendo figuras con cuadrados unitarios.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Discover what area measures by covering shapes with unit squares.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Medir el área contando cuadrados unitarios
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Measure area by counting unit squares

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Calcular el área de un rectángulo sin contar cada cuadrado
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Find the area of a rectangle without counting every square

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Dos jardines
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Two gardens

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Necesitas semillas de césped para dos jardines. Las semillas se venden según cuánto terreno cubren.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: You need grass seed for two gardens. Seed is sold by how much ground it covers.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: ¿Qué jardín necesita **más** semillas?
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Which garden needs **more** seed?

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: El jardín A
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Garden A

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: A desde luego parece más grande. Vamos a medirlo.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: A certainly looks bigger. Let's measure.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: El jardín B
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Garden B

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Vamos a medir y averiguarlo.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Let's measure and find out.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Necesitan la misma cantidad
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: They need the same amount

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Comprobemos tu intuición.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Let's check your hunch.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Cúbrelos con cuadrados
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Cover them with squares

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Los matemáticos miden cuánta superficie cubre una figura contando cuántos **cuadrados unitarios** caben dentro. Muestra los cuadrados y cuenta cada jardín.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Mathematicians measure how much surface a shape covers by counting how many **unit squares** fit inside it. Reveal the squares and count each garden.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Muestra los cuadrados unitarios y cuenta los dos jardines.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Show the unit squares and count both gardens.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Ese número es el área
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: That count is the area

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text:
Ambos jardines cubren exactamente **9 cuadrados unitarios**, así que tienen la misma **área**: 9 unidades cuadradas.

El jardín A *parece* más grande porque se extiende más: su contorno es mucho más largo. La longitud del contorno es otra medida, llamada **perímetro**. Volverás a verla en la siguiente lección.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source:
Both gardens cover exactly **9 unit squares**, so they have the same **area**: 9 square units.

Garden A *looks* bigger because it stretches further — its outline is much longer. The length of the outline is a different measurement called the **perimeter**. You'll meet it again in the next lesson.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Cuenta sin los cuadrados
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Count without the squares

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Esta vez no hay botón para «mostrar cuadrados». Usa las líneas de la cuadrícula.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: This time there's no "show squares" button. Use the grid lines.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: ¿Cuántos cuadrados unitarios cubre esta figura?
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: How many unit squares does this shape cover?

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Divide la figura en dos rectángulos: la barra de arriba y el tronco.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Split the shape into two rectangles: the bar across the top and the stem.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: La barra de arriba tiene 5 cuadrados. ¿Cuántos hay en el tronco de abajo?
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: The top bar is 5 squares. How many are in the stem below it?

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: La barra de arriba cubre 5 cuadrados y el tronco cubre 3 más: $5 + 3 = 8$. Dividir figuras en rectángulos es un truco muy útil.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: The top bar covers 5 squares and the stem covers 3 more: $5 + 3 = 8$. Splitting shapes into rectangles is a powerful trick.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Construye un área
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Build an area

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Arrastra el control redondo para cambiar el tamaño del rectángulo.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Drag the round handle to resize the rectangle.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Haz un rectángulo que cubra exactamente **12** cuadrados unitarios.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Make a rectangle that covers exactly **12** unit squares.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Un rectángulo está formado por filas iguales de cuadrados.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: A rectangle is made of equal rows of squares.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: ¿Cuántas filas de 4 cuadrados forman 12? ¿Y filas de 6?
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: How many rows of 4 squares make 12? Or rows of 6?

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Sirve cualquier rectángulo cuyo ancho × alto sea 12: 1 × 12, 2 × 6, 3 × 4 (o girado).
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Any rectangle whose width × height is 12 works: 1 × 12, 2 × 6, 3 × 4 (or turned on its side).

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Exactamente 12. Un rectángulo son filas × columnas de cuadrados, así que su área es **ancho × alto**: no hace falta contarlos uno a uno.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Exactly 12. A rectangle is rows × columns of squares, so its area is **width × height** — no need to count one by one.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Comprobación rápida
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: Quick check

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Esta vez no hay cuadrícula.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: No grid this time.

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: Una alfombra rectangular mide 7 unidades de largo y 3 de ancho. ¿Cuál es su área, en unidades cuadradas?
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: A rectangular rug is 7 units long and 3 units wide. What is its area, in square units?

chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.text: $7 \times 3 = 21$ unidades cuadradas: 3 filas de 7 cuadrados.
chapters.#area-and-shape.lessons.#what-i.source: $7 \times 3 = 21$ square units: 3 rows of 7 squares.

chapters.#fractions-as-areas.summary.text: Corta figuras en partes iguales y compara las piezas.
chapters.#fractions-as-areas.summary.source: Cut shapes into equal parts and compare pieces.

chapters.#patterns.summary.text: Predice lo que viene después y demuéstralo.
chapters.#patterns.summary.source: Predict what comes next — and prove it.

chapters.#algebra-pictures.summary.text: Convierte figuras y patrones en ecuaciones.
chapters.#algebra-pictures.summary.source: Turn shapes and patterns into equations.

chapters.#logic.summary.text: Acertijos que premian el razonamiento cuidadoso.
